Meanwhile, the winter window opened on Thursday 19 December 2024 and closed on Wednesday 15 January 2025. [[Persib Bandung|Persib]] were the defending champions after defeating [[Madura United F.C.|Madura United]] 6–1 on aggregate in the [[2023–24 Liga 1 (Indonesia)|Championship Series final]] previous season.{{Cite web |last=Setiawan |first=Arif |date=31 May 2024 |title=Hasil Final Championship Series - Kalahkan Madura United, Persib Sah Juara Liga 1 2023-2024 |url=https://www.bolasport.com/read/314098097/hasil-final-championship-series-kalahkan-madura-united-persib-sah-juara-liga-1-2023-2024 |access-date=31 May 2024 |website=Bolasport.com |language=id}} ==Overview== A total of eighteen teams will compete in the league – the fifteen teams from the previous season and three teams promoted from the [[2023–24 Liga 2 (Indonesia)|Liga 2]].{{Cite web|url=https://sport.detik.com/sepakbola/liga-indonesia/d-7320318/daftar-18-klub-liga-1-2024-25-wakil-papua-sumatera-hadir-lagi|title=Daftar 18 Klub Liga 1 2024/25, Wakil Papua-Sumatera Hadir Lagi|website=Detik.com|date=2 May 2024|access-date=2 May 2024|language=id}}
===Teams relegated to Liga 2=== The first team to be relegated were [[Persikabo 1973]] after losing 5–2 to [[Persik Kediri|Persik]] in an away match on 28 March 2024, ending their seven-years (previously as PS TNI) in the top division.{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/olahraga/20240328221203-142-1080278/persikabo-jadi-tim-pertama-degradasi-dari-liga-1-musim-ini|title=Persikabo Jadi Tim Pertama Degradasi dari Liga 1 Musim ini|website=CNN Indonesia|date=28 March 2024|access-date=2 April 2024|language=id}} The second team to be relegated were [[Bhayangkara Presisi Indonesia F.C.|Bhayangkara Presisi]]. Their rescue mission went short in Matchday 32 as relegation contender, [[Persita Tangerang|Persita]] drew 1–1 against [[Persik Kediri|Persik]]. The result ensured Bhayangkara Presisi to be unable to break out of relegation. Their fate was sealed further after a 1–2 loss in their own match of the fixture against [[Bali United F.C.|Bali United]] on 20 April 2024 and this result ended their seven-years in the top division.{{Cite web |date=20 April 2024 |title=Perjalanan Bhayangkara FC dari Persikubar, Merger dengan PS Polri, Juara, Lalu Degradasi dari Liga 1 |url=https://www.viva.co.id/bola/liga-indonesia/1707056-perjalanan-bhayangkara-fc-dari-persikubar-merger-dengan-ps-polri-juara-lalu-degradasi-dari-liga-1 |access-date=20 April 2024 |website=Viva.co.id |language=id}} The third and final team to be relegated were [[RANS Nusantara F.C.|RANS Nusantara]] after losing 3–2 to [[PSM Makassar|PSM]] in an away match on 30 April 2024, ending their two-years in the top division.{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/olahraga/20240430181623-142-1092419/klub-rans-nusantara-milik-raffi-ahmad-degradasi-dari-liga-1|title=Klub RANS Nusantara Milik Raffi Ahmad Degradasi dari Liga 1|website=CNN Indonesia|date=30 April 2024|access-date=1 May 2024|language=id}} ====Teams promoted from Liga 2==== The first two teams to earn promotion from Liga 2 were [[PSBS Biak|PSBS]] and [[Semen Padang F.C.|Semen Padang]], who were qualified to final round on 29 February 2024. PSBS defeated [[Persiraja Banda Aceh|Persiraja]] 5–1 on aggregate and this was its first promotion to the top division,{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/olahraga/20240229151008-142-1068809/psbs-biak-promosi-ke-liga-1-usai-hajar-persiraja|title=PSBS Biak Promosi ke Liga 1 Usai Hajar Persiraja|website=CNN Indonesia|date=29 February 2024|access-date=2 May 2024|language=id}} while Semen Padang defeated [[Malut United F.C.|Malut United]] 2–1 on aggregate and returned to top division after five-years absence.{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnnindonesia.com/olahraga/20240229164753-142-1068880/semen-padang-resmi-promosi-liga-1-lawan-psbs-biak-di-final-liga-2|title=Semen Padang Resmi Promosi Liga 1, Lawan PSBS Biak di Final Liga 2|website=CNN Indonesia|date=29 February 2024|access-date=2 May 2024|language=id}} Malut United was the last to be promoted after defeating Persiraja on 3–2 aggregate at promotion play-off which was held on 9 March 2024.{{Cite web|url=https://bola.kompas.com/read/2024/03/09/21431458/malut-united-promosi-ke-liga-1-kemenangan-bagi-rakyat-maluku|title=Malut United Promosi ke Liga 1, Kemenangan bagi Rakyat Maluku|website=Kompas.com|date=9 March 2024|access-date=2 May 2024|language=id}} Just like PSBS, this is the first time Malut United will compete in the top division. Starting from this season, [[Liga Indonesia Baru]] announced an increase in the foreign player quota to eight foreign players.
